Editor's Letter

August turned out 8 finishes — some smoother than others. The 1 Panel Cap was the one that fought back — 1 hour and a fair amount of swearing. Lesson filed: gaberdine does not forgive a rushed seam. As ever — everything here was made, worn, unpicked or sworn at by the editor herself.

— M
